story.title: The Mistral Cipher
story.subtitle: An aviator’s memorial dinner hides the route of a missing reconnaissance flight.
story.premise: test pilot Émile Vauban's memorial dinner for the tenth anniversary of the vanished Mistral flight brings five accomplished strangers to a house in Grambois. Each accepted a different private promise from Émile Vauban; one came to make sure that promise could never be kept.
story.hostRole: Émile Vauban, celebrated test pilot and sole public survivor; then Game Master

story.solution: René brokered the secret landing and built his career on the myth of the crash. Émile convened the memorial to correct the record. René killed him during the commemorative toast and tried to make the dispute look like rivalry between pilot and mechanic. Five private accounts reconstruct the landing and René’s foreknowledge.

clues.text: The logged fuel use is consistent with a landing, not a crash at sea.
René possessed a weather code available only to the foreign buyer’s courier.
Émile invited each guest because each held one segment of the hidden flight path.
A cottage map marks an improvised landing strip rather than wreckage.
René described the film canister before its existence was made public.
